activity.notes: Ismail Dogomuqo Berzeg was an Ubykh and Circassian military-political leader. His recorded participation in the Circassian assembly around 1830 anchors this representative public-leadership interval, ending with his death in 1846. This does not fabricate a centralized presidency or assign exact constitutional terms to the Circassian confederation.
